general: The guideline discusses carotid plaque echogenicity and its role in predicting silent cerebral infarctions.
Identification techniques for different types of plaque using ultrasound and computed tomography are explored.
Evaluation of inflammatory markers and plaque inflammation is examined using imaging techniques like MRI and PET.
Various studies analyze the effects of lipid-lowering treatments, such as statins, on the progression of atherosclerotic lesions and stroke prevention.
Guidelines for the prevention and management of transient ischemic attacks and strokes are outlined.
